facts.fact: The National Communication Authority, through its South Sudan Computer Incident Response Team (SS-CIRT), convened stakeholders at Gumbo and adopted a National Cyber Incident Management Framework; the CIRT's Assistant Director said SS-CIRT has a clear mandate as the national hub for cyber incident coordination.
